描述_EN: it is similar to yaozhou ware in its carved floral design and glaze-type, but its body is coarser, and its glaze is tinged a yellow hue, instead of the olive green common to yaozhou ware. the firing method at xunyi is also unlike that of yaozhou, and is revealed by the unglazed circle at the centre of the dish. a common space and money saving measure was to fire dishes in stacks, leaving behind an unglazed ring where the base of the dish above would have rested. during the jin dynasty (1115-1234), the xunyi kilns made wares in imitation of the widely popular yaozhou wares that were made only 70 kilometers away. this dish is an example of the ceramics made at the kilns of xunyi in the shaanxi province of china.
描述_ZN: 它的雕花图案和釉色类型与耀州器相似，但它的器身更粗，其釉色为黄色，而不是耀州器常见的橄榄绿。 旬邑的烧制方法也与耀州不同，从盘子中心的未上釉的圆圈可以看出。 一个常见的节省空间和金钱的措施是把盘子堆在一起烧，留下一个未上釉的环，上面的盘子的底部会放在那里。 在金代（1115-1234），旬邑窑模仿70公里外广为流行的耀州瓷器而制作的。 这个盘子是中国陕西省旬邑窑制造的陶瓷的一个例子。
